description: This file contains a PHP class named Security within the Opencart Admin Controller Common namespace. It manages security features related to the OpenCart admin system, including functionalities for handling security lists, installation procedures, storage management, and related administrative actions.

classes.name: Security
classes.description: A controller class that handles security-related administrative functions such as listing, installing, and managing storage associated with security features.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language resources, retrieves security list data, and renders the 'common/security' view including the user token.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Loads language resources, outputs the security list data as JSON.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns a security list as a string, also manages detection of certain directories like install, storage, admin, and their existence, and returns early if certain security conditions are not met.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation of security features, including permission checks, directory creation, moving files, and cleaning up old directories: it also handles responses in JSON format.

methods.name: storage
methods.description: Manages storage settings, directory validation, permission checks, and can move and clean storage directories, also generates JSON response about success or errors.

methods.name: admin
methods.description: Loads language resources, processes request parameters, checks permissions, directory states, and performs directory and file operations for security management, including redirecting to the login page.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes security-related directories or files based on request parameters, performs permission checks, cleans up directories, and responds with JSON status.
